summary: Dining space is clean with minimal hazards, though curtain drape length presents a slight trip risk.

hazards.title: Puddling Curtain Fabric
hazards.detail: Long curtains gather along the floor, presenting a catching hazard for feet.
fixSteps: Hem curtain panels so they hang 0.5 inches above floor level.
Use tie-backs to bundle excess fabric securely away from walkways.

hazards.title: Floor-to-Ceiling Glass Impact
hazards.detail: Large transparent glass doors lack visual markers, risking accidental collisions.
fixSteps: Apply subtle safety decals at eye level to indicate closed glass.
Ensure window latches or locks are engaged when unattended.

products.name: Safety Glass Decals
products.reason: Prevents walking into closed transparent glass patio doors.

products.name: Curtain Tiebacks
products.reason: Keeps draped fabric bundled clear of walking paths.
